questions.question: Having just taking a heavy lunch, she was not ready to have any fruit.
questions.solution: use 'taken' instead of 'taking'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'perfect participle' ka use hoga jiska structure 'having + v3' hota hai.

questions.question: I am sorry not to come to the party yesterday.
questions.solution: Use 'for not coming' in place of 'not to come'. Explanation:- Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki - 'main maafi chahunga party mein na aane ke liye' Isliye yahan 'for + gerund' structure ka use hoga.

questions.question: The manager told her that she should be a bit more careful while executed the orders of the company.
options: she should be a bit more
questions.solution: use 'executing' instead of 'executed'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan meaning dena hai ki - 'company ke orders execute karte hue' isliye yahan 'v1+ing' ka use hoga. Note :- while executing = while you are executing

questions.question: If you apologize for having fail in keeping your promises, your friends will forgive you, be sure.
options: promises, your friends will forgive you, be sure.
questions.solution: Use having failed in place of having fail. Explanation:- correct structure is 'having + v3'. Note:- having +v3 structure perfect participle and perfect gerund dono ka kaam kar sakta hai jaise ki yahan 'having failed' perfect gerund ka kaam kar rha hai jo ki preposition 'for' ka object ban raha hai.

questions.question: Do you recall to meet her at the party last night?
questions.solution: use 'meeting' instead of 'to meet'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'meet' karne ka action pehle ho chuka hai isliye usko gerund form mein likha jaaayega. Note :- Yahan 'last night' 'meet' action ke liye aaya hai na ki 'recall' ke liye, Yahan meaning ye hai ki - 'Kya tumhe yaad hai kal raat ko party me usse milna'

questions.question: Although interlinking of rivers will help tackling drought, the government has not paid much attention to this project.
options: the government has not paid much attention to this project.
questions.solution: Use 'tackle' in place of 'tackling'. Explanation:- 'Help' ke baad teen structures ban sakte hain - 'bare infinitive, infinitive aur in + gerund' but prefer karna ho toh sabse badhiya 'bare infinitive' structure ko maana jaata hai. Eg. He helped me cross/to cross/ in crossing the road. Teeno theek hain but 'cross' bare infinitive' best hai.

questions.question: Several minutes passed before she returned carry milk for the dog.
questions.solution: Use 'carrying' instead of 'carry'. Note : - yeh ssc previous year exam ka question hai aur ye challenge karne waala question tha isme do errors the 1. use 'had passed' instead of 'passed' kyunki 'pass' verb waala action 'return' se pehle hua hai isliye ise past perfect tense me likhenge. 2. use 'carrying' instead of 'carry' kyunki yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'wo wapas aayi dudh liye hue'. Note :- She came shouting = wo chillate hue aayi. she came dancing = wo naachte hue aayi. in sentence me 'v1+ing' ko adjective aur adverb dono tareeke se define kiya jaa sakta hai.

questions.question: The kitchen needs paint badly and I must get it done.
questions.solution: Use 'to be painted/ painting' in place of 'paint'. Explanation:- kyunki meaning ye hai ki 'kitchen ko paint kiye jaane ki need hai isliye yahan passive voice aayegi. Note :- Need + gerund = passive sense.

questions.question: Holiday homework are essential to keeping students busy during the vacation.
questions.solution: use 'is essential to keep' instead of 'are essential to keeping'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'holiday homework' singular subject hai uske according singular verb 'is' ka use kiya jayega, aur 'essential' ko define karne ke liye infinitive 'adverb' ka kaam karega.

questions.question: Running across the beach, my purse fell on the road, fortunately I noticed it and picked it up.
options: beach, my purse fell on the road, fortunately
I noticed it and picked it up.
questions.solution: Use While I was running in place of Running. Explanation:- Kyunki sentence mein diye structure ke according toh 'running' present participle 'purse' noun ke liye ho jayega jo ki possible nahi hai isliye 'while I was running' likh ke sentence ka meaning theek karenge.

questions.question: Mrs. Verma refused the second helping of ice cream.
questions.solution: No error. Explanation:- second helping = second serving. Yahan meaning ye hai ki: 'Mrs. Verma ne ice cream ki second serving lene se mana kr diya.

questions.question: When she entered the room, she found the child sleeping peacefully and the fan move slowly.
options: room, she found the child sleeping
peacefully and the fan move slowly.
questions.solution: Use moving in place of move. Explanation:- Kyunki 'and' conjunction se join kiya gya hai isliye parallelism maintain krenge. Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'usne paaya bachche ko sote hue aur fan ko chalte hue.'

questions.question: Though you may not be able to conquer, I exhort you to fought bravely to the last.
options: to fought bravely to the last
questions.solution: use 'to fight' instead of 'to fought' Kyunki infinitive ka structure 'to + verb' hota hai. Note :- Exhort somebody to do something = kisi ko koi kaam karne ke liye prerit karna.

questions.question: Being a rainy day, Vijay decided to stay at home and work further on the problem.
options: decided to stay at home and
questions.solution: Use It being in place of Being. Explanation:- 'Vijay' rainy day nahi hoga, balki wo din 'rainy day hoga' isliye 'day' ko refer karne ke liye 'it' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The supervisor wanted to known the pros and cons of the issue.
questions.solution: use 'know' instead of 'known'. Explanation:- Kyunki infinitive ka structure 'to + verb' hota hai.

questions.question: He does nothing but to find faults in others and laugh at them.
questions.solution: Use 'but find faults with' in place of 'but to find faults in'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'do form + nothing' aur 'but + bare infinitive' hota hai. and 'find fault with someone or something' is the correct expression He always finds faults with my food'. Note:- yahan spoken me 'in' achcha lagega but wo grammatically wrong hai.

questions.question: Airlines have increased fares because according to the new rules only limiting passengers are allowed.
questions.solution: use 'limited' instead of 'limiting'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'passengers' kisi par limit nahi laga rahe hain balki 'passengers' ke number par limit lagayi jaa rhi hai isliye 'past participle' ka use hoga.

questions.question: We advised him to marry his daughter because she had come to marriageable age.
options: she had come to marriageable age.
questions.solution: Use to get his daughter married in place of to marry his daughter. Explanation:- Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'wo apni beti ki shaadi kara den' isliye yahan causative verb ka use hoga.

questions.question: The energy required for perform various functions of the body is obtained from food.
options: for perform various functions of the body
questions.solution: Use 'to perform/ for performing' instead of 'for perform'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'purpose' batane ke liye infinitive ya 'for + gerund' structure ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He is proficient in Hindi and can speak English but he does not know to read and write English.
options: he does not know to read and write English.
questions.solution: Use how to read and write in place of to read and write. Note :- know + wh word + infinitive kyunki, I know to read = Main 'read' ko jaanta hun. I know how to read= Main jaanta hun ki 'read' kaise kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He will be leaving home at 8 a.m. to beating the office rush hour.
questions.solution: use 'beat' instead of 'beating'. Explanation:- Kyunki purpose btane ke liye infinitive ka use kiya jaata hai aur infinitive ka structure 'to + verb' hota hai.

questions.question: The doctor suggested me to take medicine regularly.
questions.solution: Use 'that I should take' in place of 'me to take'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'Suggest' verb ke baad infinitive ka use nahi hota. Note:- 'Suggest' verb ke baad gerund ka structure banta hai but 'me' lage hone ki wajah se wo possible nahi hai.

questions.question: She forgot lock the door when she went out in a hurry.
questions.solution: use 'to lock' instead of 'lock'. Explanation:- forget to do something = 'koi kaam karna bhool jaana'

questions.question: We've decided to spend our time play online games as we will not go out on a vacation this year.
questions.solution: use 'playing' instead of 'play'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan meaning ye dena hai ki - 'online games khelte hue' aur 'ta te tee' waale meaning mein 'present participle' ka use hota hai. Note:- Spend something doing something.

questions.question: A seminar was conducted apprising the new recruits of the new programmes of the company.
questions.solution: Use to apprise in place of apprising. Explanation:- Kyunki purpose batane ke liye 'infinitive' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The two trains gave the illusion of been stationary.
questions.solution: use 'being' instead of 'been'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'preposition' ke baad object aata hai, yahan 'being' gerund banega aur 'stationary' (adjective) complement banega.

questions.question: I couldn't help shedding tears at the plight of the villagers rendered homeless by a devastating cyclone.
options: at the plight of the villagers
rendered homeless by a devastating cyclone.
questions.solution: No Error. Explanation:- can/could not help + but + bare infinitive can/ could not help + gerund. Could not help shedding = Could not help crying

questions.question: She picked up the books lie on the table and put them on the shelf.
questions.solution: use 'lying' instead of 'lie'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan 'books' noun ke liye present participle (adjective) ki need hai, yahan meaning ye hai ki 'table par padi hui books'

questions.question: He claims to submit the report last Friday but I doubt that.
questions.solution: Use to have submitted in place of to submit. Explanation:- Kyunki 'claim' baad mein karte hain aur 'action' pehle aur 'claim' ke baad infinitive ka structure aata hai na ki 'gerund' ka isliye 'submit' action ko 'perfect infinitive' mein likha jaaayega.

questions.question: Before take this medicine you should consult a doctor.
questions.solution: use 'taking' instead of 'take'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'preposition' ke baad object aata hai aur object 'noun' ya 'pronoun' hota hai isliye 'take' verb ko noun banane ke liye 'gerund form' mein likhenge.

questions.question: Bhanu finished to read such a thick book in just two days.
questions.solution: use 'reading' instead of 'to read'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'finish' verb ke baad gerund ka use hota hai. Finish doing something.

questions.question: Laws and rules are made to safeguarding our rights and protect us.
questions.solution: use 'to safeguard' instead of 'to safeguarding'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'purpose' ko dikhane ke liye infinitive (to + verb) ka use hota hai.

questions.question: There was enough evidence to convict him on selling of fake medicines.
questions.solution: use 'of selling fake medicines' in place of 'on selling of'. Explanation:- convict verb iss structure mein use ki jaati hai :- convict somebody of something convict him of selling fake medicines. Aur sath hi 'selling' gerund transitive verb se bana hai isliye iske baad 'preposition' nahi aayegi seedha object aaayega. 'fake medicines'

questions.question: They will be ready leaving for the airport in an hour.
questions.solution: use 'ready to leave' instead of 'ready leaving'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'ready' adjective ko qualify karne ke liye infinitive 'to leave' ka use hoga jo adverb banega. he is ready to leave. he is ready to dance. he is ready to sing.

questions.question: They are planning for settling in Mumbai with their son.
questions.solution: use 'to settle' instead of 'for settling'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'plan' verb ke baad infinitive ka use hota hai. Plan to do something.

questions.question: Behavior modification techniques are often used to the training of police dogs.
questions.solution: use 'to train' instead of 'to the training of'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'purpose' show karne ke liye 'infinitive ka use kiya jaata hai aur 'to train' infinitive transitive verb' se bana hai isliye 'of' preposition bhi nahi aayegi seedha object aayega 'police dogs'. Note :- Waise yahan 'used in the training of' karke bhi sahi kar sakte hai.

questions.question: Our twenty-first century society expects all relevant information to simply be handing to us.
questions.solution: use 'handed to it' instead of 'handing to us'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan meaning ke according 'infinitive' ke passive form ki requirement hai isliye 'to + be + v3' ka use hoga sath hi society ke liye last me 'us' nahi 'it' pronoun ka use hona chahiye.

questions.question: You had better not to try and feed the animals in the zoo, it is forbidden.
options: You had better not to try
questions.solution: Remove 'to' from 'to try'. Explanation:- kyunki 'had better' ke baad bare infinitive ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: The country has to struggled with the problems of child labour.
questions.solution: use 'has to struggle' instead of 'has to struggled'. Explanation:- kyunki 'have to, has to, had to' yeh sab pseudo modals hote hain inka meaning 'must' modal jaisa hota hai aur inke baad verb ki 'base form' aati hai.

questions.question: We must get this post send as soon as possible.
questions.solution: use 'sent' instead of 'send'. Explanation:- Yahan 'get' causative verb hai aur 'post' 'send' verb ka receiver hai isliye 'sent (past participle) ka use hoga.

questions.question: We watched the workmen to repair the tiles of the kitchen.
questions.solution: use 'repairing/repair' instead of 'to repair'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'watch' verb ke baad yahan 'object + object complement' ka structure ban rha hai aur object complement ke roop mein 'watch' ke baad present participle ya bare infinitive ka use hota hai. Watch someone doing or do something

questions.question: Anita enjoyed to swim in the sea.
questions.solution: use 'swimming' instead of 'to swim'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'enjoy' ke baad gerund ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He wouldn't let anyone to drive his new car.
questions.solution: Remove 'to'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'let' ke baad 'bare infinitive' ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Wealth creators are essential for money to distributed in the economy.
questions.solution: use 'to be distributed' instead of 'to distributed'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'money' yahan 'distribute' ka receiver hai, isliye yahan infinitive ki passive form use ki jaaayegi.

questions.question: The child always goes for sleep with his teddy bear.
questions.solution: use 'to' instead of 'for'. Explanation:- Kyunki kisi action ke purpose ko show karne ke liye 'to' infinitive ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: He started life as a teacher before turn to journalism.
questions.solution: use 'turning' instead of 'turn'. Explanation:- Kyunki preposition ke baad object aata hai jo ki 'noun' ya 'pronoun' hote hain isliye 'turn' verb ko noun banane ke liye usse gerund form 'turning' mein likhenge.

questions.question: The company has invested a great deal of time and effort to setting up new training schemes.
options: time and effort to setting up
questions.solution: use 'to set up/in setting up' instead of 'to setting up'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan ye 2 structures possible hain. invest time to do something invest time in doing something

questions.question: She wanted to bake a cake for both her brothers.
questions.solution: No error. Explanation:- 'want' verb ke baad 'infinitive' hi aata hai isliye wahan koi galti nahi hai.

questions.question: I was reading the newspaper when I heard the sound of bullets been fired.
questions.solution: use 'being' instead of 'been'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'bullets' fire kiye jaane ki receiver hain isliye passive structure ka use hoga:- bullets being fired

questions.question: The reduction in the cost of education due to an increase in subsidies offer by the government is also seen as a reason to become more educated.
options: The reduction in the cost of education
is also seen as a reason
due to an increase in subsidies
questions.solution: use 'offered' instead of 'offer'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan 'offered' koi verb nahi balki past participle banega jo 'subsidies' ke liye aaya hai.

questions.question: We're looking forward to go to Switzerland next month.
questions.solution: replace 'to go' with 'to going'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'look forward' ke baad 'to' preposition aati hai isliye aage prepositional object aayega isliye 'going' gerund ka use hoga.

questions.question: crossing the road, my pen fell off my pocket.
questions.solution: Replace 'crossing' with 'while I was crossing'. Explanation:- Kyunki question mein diye gaye structure ke according 'road cross' karne ka kaam 'pen' karega jo ki sahi nahi hai isliye 'while I was crossing the road' likh kar meaning sahi karenge.

questions.question: Razzaq being a notorious criminal, he was sent to jail.
questions.solution: remove 'he'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'being a notorious criminal' aur 'was sent to jail' dono ka subject of reference same hai 'Razzaq' jo ki sentence ke shuru mein likha jaa chuka hai isliye dobara 'he' likhne ki need nahi hai.

questions.question: having breakfast, she left for office with her husband.
questions.solution: replace 'having breakfast' with 'having had/taken breakfast or after having breakfast'. Explanation:- Kyunki koi person breakfast karte karte nahi, balki karne ke baad office se niklega isliye yahan 'perfect participle' ya 'after + gerund' structure ka use hoga.

questions.question: According to him, it is better to sacrifice his life than to turn disloyal to his country.
options: than to turn disloyal to his country
questions.solution: replace 'to turn' with 'turn'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'than' conjunction se jab 2 infinitives join hote hain toh baad waale ko 'bare' form mein likha jaata hai.

questions.question: They served us a steamed cup of tea with some bread and butter.
options: a steamed cup of tea with
questions.solution: Replace 'steamed' with 'steaming'. Explanation:- Kyunki steamed cup :- cup jise bhaanp lagayi gayi ho. steaming cup :- cup jisme se bhaanp nikal rahi ho. Yahan meaning ke according present participle ki need hai.

questions.question: He proposed to change the name of the company.
questions.solution: replace 'to change' with 'changing'. Explanation:- kyunki 'propose' verb ke baad generally 'that + clause' ya 'gerund' ka use hota hai. Eg. He proposed visiting Manali next week. They proposed repairing the tank. He proposed that I should run the company.

questions.question: They bade him to leave their office immediately
questions.solution: replace 'to leave' with 'leave'. Explanation:- kyunki 'bid' verb ke baad 'bare infinitive' ka use hota hai. Note :- yeh structure padhne me thoda ajeeb lagta hai but grammar ke according yahi sahi structure hai. He bade her be careful. They bade him go away.

questions.question: Earlier she was a teetotaller but now she is not averse to drink.
options: now she is not averse to drink.
questions.solution: replace 'to drink' with 'to drinking'. Explanation:- kyunki 'averse' adjective ke baad 'to' preposition fix hoti hai aur preposition ka object banane ke liye 'drink' ko gerund form 'drinking' mein change kar denge.

questions.question: You should not risk to travel in this harsh weather.
questions.solution: replace 'to travel' with 'travelling'. Explanation:- kyunki 'risk' verb ke baad infinitive nahi gerund ka use hota hai. Eg. He risked losing his home for her.

questions.question: Blind by a dust storm, they fell into disorder.
questions.solution: yahan meaning dena hai ki 'dust storm ke dwara blind kiye jaane ki wajah se...' aur 'by' preposition se bhi passive meaning ka hint mil rha hai. Past participle passive ka sense convey karta hai isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: You must not insists on help people who don't want it.
questions.solution: Insist ke sath 'on' preposition aati hai aur preposition ka object dene ke liye gerund ka use hoga isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: She has checked everything she needs before started work.
questions.solution: yahan 'before' ke baad iska object dene ke liye verb ko gerund form me likhenge. Isliye D option before starting work sahi hai. Note - 'work' noun 'starting' gerund ka object banega.

questions.question: The first step in making a kite is to fasten two sticks of bamboo together in the form of a cross.
options: in making a kite is to be fastened
in making a kite is to fastening
into making a kite is fasten
questions.solution: Question mein diya gya structure 'in making a kite is to fasten' sahi hai kyunki yahan meaning ye dena hai ki- 'Kite banane mein first step hota hai two sticks.'

questions.question: The scientists are busy to explore new ideas.
questions.solution: busy + v1+ing and 'go' verb + vi+ing structure allowed hote hain. Eg. He is busy studying. (wo padhne mein busy hai) He went shopping. (wo shopping karne gya tha) inme busy ke baad and went ke baad preposition understood ho jati hai. Isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: They made us to wait while they were checking our documents.
questions.solution: ye causative verb pe based question hai. Causative verb mein doer wale case me bare infinitive aata hai aur yahan past ki baat ho rhi hai isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: The eighteenth century saw the middle classes becoming most prosperous.
questions.solution: 'saw' verb ke baad bare infinitive and present participle dono structure use hote hain. Eg. We saw him dance. We saw him dancing. lekin meaning ke according middle classes more prosperous hongi naki most prosperous. isliye C option sahi hai.

questions.question: Austin can be saw chasing cops with a sickle.
questions.solution: 'can' modal ke baad verb ki base form aayegi aur 'be' ke baad V3 kyuki passive meaning dena hai isliye A option 'can be seen' sahi hai.

questions.question: Do you mind me to being here while you are working?
options: you can mind me to be
you will mind me to being
questions.solution: 'mind' verb ke baad gerund ka use hota hai. isliye C option 'do you mind my being here' sahi hai.

questions.question: I was look forward to helping you complete the project.
questions.solution: 'look forward' phrasal verb hai aur agar iska 'ing' form bnana ho to wo hoga 'looking forward' aisa koi option nhi hai isliye was ko hta ke 'look forward' use karenge aur look forward ke baad 'to + gerund' aata hai isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: I found my bag to lie where I had left it.
questions.solution: yahan meaning dena hai ki 'muje mera bag whi pda hua mila jha maine chora tha' iss meaning ke liye C option 'I found my bag lying...' sahi hai.

questions.question: We watched the workman to be removing the damaged tiles.
questions.solution: 'watch' verb ke baad jab infinitive ko object complement bnate hain to usko bare infinitive form mein likhte hain. isliye B option 'remove' sahi hai.

questions.question: Keep pets can be very comforting for most people.
questions.solution: yahan verb ke liye subject chahiye isliye 'Keeping pets' ka use hoga. isme 'keeping' gerund subject banega aur 'pets' noun gerund ka object. Isliye D option sahi hai. Note :- A option isliye galat hai kyuki agar 'pet' singular likhenge toh uske pehle 'a' article hona chahiye tha.

questions.question: As been rich, he can afford this expensive treatment.
questions.solution: 'being rich' = ameer hone ki wajah se. isliye meaning and grammar ke according yahan C option sahi hai.

questions.question: We have finished our work for the day, so let we go home early today.
questions.solution: Let verb ke baad generally object + bare infinitive ka structure banta hai. Eg. Let us go, Let me dance, Let me sing. etc. isliye yahan B option sahi hai.

questions.question: The porter denied to take the money.
questions.solution: 'deny' verb ke baad gerund ka use kiya jata hai isliye A option 'denied taking' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Have taken permission, Shivam went horse riding.
questions.solution: yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'permission lene ke baad wo ....' isliye yahan perfect participle ka use hoga. isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: He was greatly disappointed to be failed again.
questions.solution: kisi cheez pe disappointed hone ke liye generally 'disappointed at + noun/gerund' structure ka use hota hai. isliye yahan D option sahi hai.

questions.question: Be polite and courteous will greatly improve your chances of making friends at your new office.
questions.solution: yahan 'will improve' verb ke liye subject ki requirement hai isliye 'being polite and courteous' ka use hoga. isme 'Being' gerund subject banega aur 'polite and courteous' ye dono adjective 'complement' bnenge kyuki 'being' gerund linking verb se bna hai.

questions.question: We could not help but laughing at his weird fall.
questions.solution: yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'hum khud ho rok nhi paye hasne se' iske liye 2 structure use kiye jate hain 'could not help but + bare infinitive' ya 'could not help + gerund'. ye dono hi structures sahi hote hain. Dono ek sath options mein nhi aate. C option mein sahi structure hai isliye wo sahi hai.

questions.question: Having been finished his early-morning workout routine and meditation session, (a)/ he enjoyed a healthy breakfast (b)/ and left for his office. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'been'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'early morning routine aur meditation finish karne ke baad, usne enjoy kiya breakfast', toh sentence mein 'he' 'having been finished' kaam ka doer hai, isliye perfect participle passive mein nahi active voice mein likhenge, isliye 'having finished' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She felt deeply ashamed for interrupt (a)/ the speaker during the serious discussion (b)/ as she didn't realize the importance of the topic (c)/ and spoke without thinking about the consequences. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'interrupt' with 'interrupting'. Explanation:- 'for' preposition hai jiske baad preposition ka object aata hai jo ki noun yaa pronoun hota hai, 'interrupt' verb hai isliye isse gerund(noun) 'interrupting' mein change karna padega.

questions.question: The security team remained alert while checked the identities of the visitors (a)/ entering the research facility, to ensure no unauthorized individual (b)/ entered the restricted area. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'checked' with 'checking'. Explanation:-Sentence ka matlab hai 'security team alert thi visitors ki identity check karne ke dauran', toh sentence mein continuity show karni hai, isliye yahan 'checked' ki jagah 'checking' aaayega, jo ki short form hoti hai 'while they were checking' ki, isliye yahan 'checking' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Do you recall (a)/ to meet Arjun and his startup team at the tech summit in Bengaluru last month, (b)/ where they were explaining their AI-based flood-prediction system? (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to meet' with 'meeting'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'last month' 'meet' ke liye aaya hai, 'do you recall' se pata chal raha hai ki milne ka action pehle hee ho chuka hai, agar koi action pehle ho chuka ho yaa sath-sath ho toh 'gerund' ka use karte hai, aur future mein hone ke liye 'infinitive' ka use karte hai, sentence mein 'milna' past mein hua hai, isliye yahan gerund 'meeting' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Regular morning meditation helps (a)/ students improving their concentration and memory, (b)/ especially when they are preparing for demanding competitive exams like SSC and UPSC. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'improving' with 'improve'. Explanation:- 'help' verb ke sath 'bare infinitive(improve)/ infinitive (to improve)/gerund(in improving)' teeno structure sahi hote hai, lekin 'bare infinitive' ko prefer karte hai, isliye sentence mein preferred structure 'improve' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The professor entered the classroom (a)/ hold a stack of research papers and (b)/ a cup of black coffee in his hand. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'hold' with 'holding'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'professor classroom mein enter hue research papers ka stack liye huye', toh jab yeh meaning dena ho ki 'yeh kaam hua yeh karte hue', toh present participle (v1+ing) ka use karte hai, isliye meaning ke according 'hold' ki jagah 'holding' present participle sahi hoga. Ex:- he entered the room carrying a glass of milk, matlab (wo room mein enter hua milk ka glass liye hue).

questions.question: The old railway bridge needs to repair immediately (a)/ before any major accident occurs, (b)/ as the recent inspection report highlighted multiple cracks in its structure. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to repair' with 'to be repaired, repairing'. Explanation:- Iss sentence mein 'railway bridge' repair hone ka receiver hai matlab 'railway bridge ko repair karna hai', isliye isse passive voice mein likhenge, isliye 'to be repaired' sahi hoga, aur 'need' verb ke baad 'ing' likhne se automatic passive wala meaning aa jata hai, isliye yahan 'repairing' bhi sahi hoga. isliye 'to be repaired' passive yaa 'repairing' dono sahi honge.

questions.question: Walking through the crowded metro station, (a)/ my wallet was stolen from my bag, (b)/ and I had to report the incident immediately to the security officer. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'walking' with 'while I was walking'. Explanation:- 'walking...se lekar....station' tak yeh phrase comma ke baad likhe noun ke liye aata hai, lekin 'walking' wala kaam 'wallet' nahi karega, isliye 'walking' ko verb maanke iska relation 'I' se banana padega, jiske liye 'while I was walking' likhna padega, sentence ka matlab hoga 'jab mein metro station se jaa raha tha, mera wallet chori ho gaya bag mein se'. jahan 'while' ek conjunction hai.

questions.question: At the community feast organized by the local temple, (a)/ many children asked for a second helping (b)/ of the sweet rice pudding prepared especially for the festival. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: No error

questions.question: The principal instructed the students (a)/ to completing the group project by the end of the week (b)/ and submit the report to their class mentors for evaluation. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to completing' with 'to complete'. Explanation:- 'instruct' ek di-transitive verb hoti hai jiska structure 'instruct somebody to do something' hota hai, jisme 'students' indirect object aur 'infinitive' direct object banega, isliye yahan 'students' ke baad infinitive 'to complete' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Being a rainy evening with heavy traffic on the main road, (a)/ Riya decided to cancel her dinner plans, (b)/ and stay home with her family. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: put 'it' before 'being'. Explanation:- 'Being a rainy evening' aur 'Riya' dono aapas mein link nahi honge kyunki 'iya' rainy evening nahi hai, wo 'evening' ek 'rainy evening' thi, jiske liye 'it' introductory subject ka use 'being' se pehle karenge, isliye 'It being a rainy evening' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Our boss does nothing (a)/ but to find faults in every proposal (b)/ presented by us in the weekly business meetings. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to find faults in' with 'find faults with'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'do(forms) + nothing but + bare infinitive' ka structure follow ho raha hai jisme 'does' ke according bare infinitive/base form 'find' aayega aur 'fault' ke sath 'with' aayega kyunki 'fault with' ek fix expression hota hai, iske sath 'in' preposition galat hai, isliye 'but find faults with' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As per the new safety regulations (a)/ introduced by the government, only vaccinating employees (b)/ are allowed to enter the corporate building. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'vaccinating' with 'vaccinated'. Explanation:- 'vaccinating' ki jagah 'vaccinated' aayega kyunki 'employees' vaccine waale kaam ke receiver hai, sentence ka matlab 'aise employees jinhe vaccine lagi ho', isliye yahan 'vaccinated' past participle sahi answer hoga. Note:- 'vaccinating' present participle tab aate, jab yeh iss kaam ke doer hote, 'vaccine lagane waale employees'.

questions.question: At the community gathering, several relatives (a)/ suggested that Mr. Sinha should marry his eldest son again, (b)/ as he had been living alone for years after his wife's death in an accident. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'marry his eldest son' with 'get his eldest son married'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'should marry his eldest son' se matlab hoga 'mr sinha apne eldest son se shaadi karle', lekin meaning chahiye 'apne eldest son ki shaadi karade' jiske liye causative verb ka use karna padega, isliye yahan 'get his eldest son married' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Although Sarah has learned the basics of photography, (a)/ she does not know to use professional cameras with manual settings, (b)/ which limits her ability to capture high-quality images in various lighting conditions. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: put 'how' after 'know'. Explanation:- Agar 'know' verb ke sath 'infinitive' likhte hai toh beech mein adverb ki jarurat padti hai, toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'how' adverb sahi hogi, isliye 'does not know how to use' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The doctor suggested (a)/ him to avoid eating fried food regularly (b)/ as it was worsening his cholesterol level and overall health. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'him to avoid' with 'that he should avoid'. Explanation:- Kuch verb jaise 'suggest, apologize, plead, talk etc.' agar inke baad indirect object aate hai, toh indirect object se pehle 'to' preposition ka use karte hai aur inn verbs ke sath 'infinitive' galat hota hai. agar indirect object nahi diya hota ho toh direct 'avoiding' gerund ka use karte, lekin indirect object diya hai, isliye 'suggest' ke baad 'that' se clause bana ke likhenge, isliye 'suggested that he should avoid' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Ravi was in such a hurry to catch the early morning flight (a)/ that he completely forgot switching off the AC (b)/ which later resulted in a short circuit. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'switching off' with 'to switch off'. Explanation:-'forgot' ke baad 'infinitive' aur 'gerund' dono aata hai, 'gerund' tab lagate hai 'jab aapne wo kaam kar liya lekin aap bhool gaye ki aapne kaam kiya ki nahi' aur 'infinitive' tab lagate hai 'jab aap wo kaam karna hee bhool gaye', sentence mein bataya ki 'uske chakkar mein short circuit hua, iska matlab wo 'switch off' karna bhool gaya, isliye yahan infinitive 'to switch off' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: After retirement, Mr. Sharma spends most of his mornings (a)/ read newspapers and gardening in his backyard (b)/ which keep him both physically and mentally active. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'read' with 'reading'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'mr. Sharma apni subah bitate hai newspaper padhte hue aur gardening karte hue', toh jab yeh meaning dena hoki 'yeh kaam karte hai yeh karte hue' iss waale meaning ke liye present participle (v1+ing) ka structure ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'read' ki jagah 'reading' sahi answer hoga. Ex:- 'I spent my afternoon playing video games, matlab 'maine apni afternoon bitai video games khelte hue'

questions.question: The government launched a new online portal (a)/ assisting farmers with real-time weather updates and digital crop advisory (b)/ so that they could plan their harvest more effectively. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'assisting' with 'to assist'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'assisting' ki jagah 'to assist' aayega kyunki sentence mein verb se why ka reply dena hai ki online portal launch kyu kiya gaya, aur why ke reply ke liye 'infinitive' ka use karte hai, isliye yahan 'to assist' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: After been criticized by the media for poor maintenance of roads, (a)/ the municipal corporation finally (b)/ started the repair work across the city to avoid further backlash. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'after been criticized' with 'after being criticized/ having been criticized'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'after been criticized' passive voice mein toh sahi hai lekin 'been' bina helping verb ke nahi aa sakta, sentence ka matlab hai 'criticize hone ke baad' jiska passive 'being + v3' se banega, isliye 'been' ki jagah 'being' ka use karenge, isliye 'after being criticized' sahi answer hoga. aur perfect participle ka passive karke bhi iska answer ho sakta hai, jisme 'after' ki bhi jarurat nahi hai, isliye 'having been criticized' bhi sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As the audience stood up (a)/ to applaud the young pianist, his mother (b)/ sitting in the front row couldn't help cry out of pride and joy. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'cry' with 'crying'. Explanation:- 'can't help' ka matlab 'rok nahi pana' agar iske baad 'but' aaye toh bare infinitive aata hai, agar 'but' naa aaye toh 'gerund' ka use hota hai, sentence mein 'but' nahi hai, isliye 'couldn't help' ke baad gerund 'crying' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The CEO claims to submit (a)/ the complete set of financial disclosures to the regulatory authority last week (b)/ while the audit team is saying that several critical documents are still missing from the official record. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to submit' with 'to have submitted'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'last week' se pata chal raha ki past ke action ki baat hai, lekin 'to submit' infinitive diya hai aur infinitive aise kaam ke liye lagta hai jo aage hona ho, aur 'claim' verb ke sath infinitive bhi use karna hai, isliye infinitive ka bhi use ho aur past ke action ki bhi baat ho jaaye iske liye perfect infinitive 'to+have+v3' ka use karenge, isliye 'to have submitted' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The anti-narcotics unit in Goa (a)/ submitted a detailed report to the court (b)/ accusing a well-known nightclub owner of supply banned substances to tourists in late-night parties. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'supply' with 'supplying'. Explanation:- Accuse somebody of doing something.

questions.question: After finishing their final briefing at the Border Security Camp near Tawang, (a)/ the young officers said that they would be ready leaving for the high-altitude patrol route (b)/ as soon as the weather department issued a green signal. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'leaving' with 'to leave'. Explanation:- 'ready' ka matlab koi kaam karne ke liye taiyaar hona, matlab wo kaam future mein hoga, aur koi kaam future mein karne ke liye infinitive ka use karte hai, isliye 'to leave' sahi answer hoga. Ex:- 'ready to go there, ready to dance, ready to help you etc.'

questions.question: Aarav's family is planning for moving back to their hometown in Dehradun (a)/ as his father wants to start organic farming (b)/ after retiring from his job. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'for moving' with 'to move'. Explanation:- 'planning' ke sath 'for' mein koi dikkat nahi hai agar aage noun likha ho, lekin 'planning' verb ke aage action likhna hai, toh obvious baat hai wo action future mein hoga, aur jo kaam future mein hone hote hai uske liye infinitive ka use karte hai, aur action ke liye 'planning' verb ka structure 'planning to do something' hota hai, isliye yahan 'to move' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Many parents nowadays (a)/ want all school-related information, (b)/ including exam schedules and fee reminders, to be providing to them directly on their WhatsApp. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to be providing' with 'to be provided'. Explanation:- Agar 'want' verb ke baad doer likhte ho toh infinitive active form mein aata hai jaise 'I want you to go there' aur 'want' ke baad receiver likhte ho toh infinitive passive form mein aata hai jaise 'I want this parcel to be delivered', toh sentence mein 'information' receiver hai, matlab 'information provide kari jaaye', isliye yahan infinitive passive form mein aaayega, isliye 'to be provided' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Rahul had planned a late-night trek near the India–Nepal border, (a)/ but the local guide warned him that he had better not to walk alone (b)/ because wild animals often roam in that forest area. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to walk' with 'walk'. Explanation:- 'had better/ had rather/ would better/ would rather' yeh words 'pseudo modal' hote hai jinke meaning 'should' jaisa hota hai, isliye inke sath verb ki base form aati hai, isliye yahan 'walk' verb ki base form sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As very heavy rainfall is expected this year, (a)/ villagers in Assam have to rebuilt the damaged embankments (b)/ before the next spell of floods threatens their homes again. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'rebuilt' with 'rebuild'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'rebuilt' ki jagah 'rebuild' aayega kyunki 'have to, has to, had to' yeh words model ki tarah kaam karte hai aur model ke baad verb ki base form aati hai, isliye 'rebuild' verb ki 1st form sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: While visiting the emergency (a)/ ward of AIIMS Delhi, Rohan watched the (b)/ paramedics to revive an unconscious accident victim (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to revive' with 'revive'. Explanation:- Kuch verbs jaise 'let, bid, make, see, notice, feel, watch, help etc.' inke sath bare infinitives aate hai jisme object + object complement ka structure banta hai, jisme infinitive se object complement ka kaam lete hai toh infinitive bare form mein aata hai, isliye yahan 'paramedics revive' sahi answer hoga. Note:- gerund bhi aa sakta hai jab usne jhalak dekhi hoti uss kaam ki, agar poora action dekha hai toh bare infinitive. Dono ke apna-apna meaning hai.

questions.question: At the annual harvest festival in the village, (a)/ the children enjoyed to dance around the bonfire (b)/ while their elders narrated folk stories. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to dance' with 'dancing'. Explanation:- 'enjoy' ke sath 'gerund' aate hai jab do kaam sath mein ho yaa koi pehle ho chuka ho, aur koi kaam jab baad mein ho toh 'infinitive' aata hai, verb ki 2nd form se pata chal raha ki kaam pehle hee ho chuka hai, isliye yahan 'dancing' gerund sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Dr. Nisha did not let her (a)/ interns to operate the newly-calibrated laser instrument (b)/ without wearing high-density protective gear. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to operate' with 'operate'. Explanation:- Kuch verbs jaise 'let, bid, make, see, notice, feel, watch, help etc.' inke sath bare infinitives aate hai jisme object + object complement ka structure banta hai, jisme infinitive se object complement ka kaam lete hai toh infinitive bare form mein aata hai, isliye yahan 'operate' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Principal Meenakshi stated (a)/ that modern digital labs are necessary in schools (b)/ for complex scientific concepts to absorb easily by students. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to absorb' with 'to be absorbed'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'to absorb' infinitive ka passive form aayegi kyunki scientific concept absorb nahi karenge, balki scientific concepts ko absorb kiya jaaayega students ke dwara, toh meaning ke according passive form aayegi, isliye yahan 'to be absorbed' passive form sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The scholarship announced by the education ministry (a)/ brought immense hope to students living in remote tribal areas (b)/ where facilities provide by the government schools (c)/ were insufficient for higher studies. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'provide' with 'provided'. Explanation:- Agar doer ke sath likhte hai 'present participle' aata hai aur receiver ke sath likhte hai 'past participle' aata hai, toh sentence mein 'facilities' kuch provide nahi karengi, balki facilities ko provide kiya jaaayega, iska matlab 'facilities' receiver hui, isliye yahan 'provided' past participle sahi answer hoga. Jaise sentence mein 'student living' jisme 'students' doer hai, isliye 'living' present participle mein aaya hai.

questions.question: Our entire marketing team is looking (a)/ forward to attend the three-day workshop (b)/ where industry leaders will share modern branding techniques (c)/ that can significantly improve customer engagement. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'attend' with 'attending'. Explanation:- Kuch phrase jaise 'look forward to, with a view to, accustomed to, vulnerable to, prone to, addicted to etc' yeh saare aise phrases jinke sath 'to' preposition fix hoti hai aur inke baad 'gerund' aate hai, isliye yahan 'attending' gerund sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Running to catch the morning metro, (a)/ my headphones slipped out of my backpack (b)/ and got stuck between the sliding doors. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'running' with 'while I was running'. Explanation:- Agar 'running' present participle banega, toh iska relation 'headphone' se hoga jo ki galat hai, isliye 'running' ko verb banakar 'my' doer se relation banayenge, jiske liye 'while I was running' likhna padega. Jisse sentence ka matlab hoga 'jab mein bhaag raha tha metro padkane ke liye, mere headphone slip ho gaye bag se'. Yahan 'while' ek conjunction hai.

questions.question: Tanisha, being extremely anxious about missing her metro, (a)/ she rushed past the security check (b)/ without noticing that her bag's zip was open. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'she' before 'rushed'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'Tanisha' subject hai aur 'being....se lekar....metro' tak yeh adjectival phrase hai jo Tanisha ke liye likha hai, toh subject ko verb ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'Tanisha' ke liye likha 'she' pronoun ko hatana padega, jisse 'rushed' verb 'Tanisha' ke liye ho jaayegi.

questions.question: Having her lunch, (a)/ Priya started her work again in the balcony (b)/ as she had to submit the final report by next Monday. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'having her lunch' with 'having had her lunch'. Explanation:- Sentence mein jab hume yeh dikhaana ho ki ek kaam khatam hone ke baad dusra kaam hua hai, toh iske liye 'perfect participle' ka use karte hai jiska structure 'having + v3' hota hai, sentence mein 'work again' se pata chal raha ki priya ne pehle kaam kiya hoga uske baad lunch phir dubara kaam, toh khaana khaane ke liye 'have' ki 3rd form 'had' ka use hoga, isliye 'having had her lunch' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As soon as we entered the hotel (a)/ the waiter brought (b)/ a steamed cup of tea (c)/ and some biscuits for all of us. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'steamed' with 'steaming'. Explanation:- Agar doer ke sath likhte hai 'present participle' aata hai aur receiver ke sath likhte hai 'past participle' aata hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'aisa cup jisme se bhaap nikal rahi ho', toh 'cup of tea' doer hai 'steam' ka, isliye yahan present participle 'steaming' sahi answer hoga. Ex of past participle:-'steamed rice' matlab 'aise rice jo steam mein bane ho', 'steamed momo' matlab 'aise momo jo steam mein bane ho'.

questions.question: Anshika proposed to joining a library (a)/ so that she and her friends could study(b)/ peacefully for their first-year exams and score well. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'to' before 'joining'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'joining' ke pehle 'to' nahi aayega kyunki 'propose, suggest' verb ke baad direct human being aur infinitive galat hota hai, lekin inke baad gerund yaa 'that' se clause bana ke likh sakte hai, sentence mein 'that' se clause isliye nahi banayenge kyunki propose ke baad mention nahi hai kisko propose kiya, isliye yahan 'to' hatane se 'joining' gerund ban jaayega 'proposed' verb ka.

questions.question: As the groom's family approached the entrance, (a)/ the bandmaster bade (b)/ his musicians to play the special ceremonial tune (c)/ which had been rehearsed for weeks to make the moment grand. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to play' with 'play'. Explanation:- Kuch verbs jaise 'let, bid, make, notice, watch, feel etc.' inke baad bare infinitive aate hai. 'bid' verb ki forms 'bid, bade, bidden' hoti hai, isliye 'bade' ke baad bare infinitive 'play' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Both Kunal and Ajay have told me (a)/ that they are not averse to end this online fight (b) and they are ready to work with each other peacefully (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'end' with 'ending'. Explanation:- Kuch phrase jaise 'look forward to, with a view to, accustomed to, vulnerable to, prone to, addicted to, averse to etc' yeh saare aise phrases hai jinke sath 'to' preposition fix hoti hai aur inke baad 'gerund' aate hai, isliye yahan 'ending' gerund sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: You should not risk to carry your expensive camera (a)/ while boarding a heavily crowded local train (b)/ during the festive season. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to carry' with 'carrying'. Explanation:- Kuch verbs jaise 'detest, mind, risk, engage, admire, resist, avoid, delay etc.' inke baad gerunds aate hai, isliye yahan 'to carry' infinitive ki jagah 'carrying' gerund sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It is healthier to wake up early for a morning walk (a)/ than to lie in bed scrolling (b)/ through pointless videos for hours. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'to lie' with 'lie'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'lie' se pehle 'to' nahi aayega, agar do infinitive conjunction se jude hote hai toh dusra infinitive bare form mein aata hai, 'to wake up' aur 'to lie' infinitives 'than' conjunction se jude hai, isliye 'lie' ke pehle 'to' nahi aayega.

questions.question: Shaken by the sudden death of his father, he stopped talking to anyone.
The doctor repeatedly insists on reduce the patient's screen time, especially because excessive usage was worsening his sleep cycle and affecting his concentration during the day.
questions.solution: 'insist' ke sath 'on' preposition aati hai aur 'on' preposition ke baad preposition ke object(noun) chahiye, kyunki 'reduce' verb hoti hai, isliye 'ing' lagake gerund(noun) mein change kar denge, isliye option B 'insisted on reducing' sahi option hoga.

questions.question: The hikers packed enough food and emergency supplies before set out on their long journey through the dense forest.
questions.solution: 'before' preposition hai jiske baad object(noun) chahiye, kyunki 'set' verb hoti hai, isliye 'ing' lagake gerund(noun) 'setting' mein badal denge, isliye option C aur D galat honge. Journey ke liye nikalne ke liye 'set out, set off' phrasal verb ka use hota hai, isliye option A bhi galat hoga, toh 'before setting out' option B sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: One of the essential steps in organising a large cultural event is to arranging the seating plan properly so that every guest has a clear view of the stage.
options: in organising a large cultural event is to be arranging
into organising a large cultural event is arrange
in organising a large cultural event is to arrange
in organising a large cultural event is to be arranged
questions.solution: Iss type ke structures ko example mein diye gaye sentences se samjhiye:- The important step is to concentrate. The best thing is to avoid such issues. The only solution is to confront him. Inn sentences mein infinitive aur gerund dono use ho sakte hai. question ke option mein infinitive wala structure tha isliye option C sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The students were busy to prepare for their upcoming annual exhibition as they had to arrange charts, models, and presentations.
questions.solution: 'busy' ke sath 'with' preposition aati hai jiske baad noun aata hai, lekin jab koi action batana ho toh direct 'ing' form mein likh sakte hai, isliye option C 'preparing' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The in-charge made the technicians to work overnight so that the power supply could be restored before the city woke up in the morning.
questions.solution: Yeh ek 'make/have' causative verb ka sentence hai jisme 'technicians' 'work' ka doer hai, isliye 'to work' infinitive ko bare infinitive mein likhenge, isliye option C 'made the technicians work' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Do you mind me to staying here until I find a good house to rent?
questions.solution: Sentence ka matlab hai 'mera rukna mind toh nahi karoge', toh 'mind' verb ka object 'stay' banega, kyunki 'stay' verb hota hai, isliye isse 'staying' gerund mein change karenge, aur gerund(noun) ke sath 'me' pronoun nahi aaayega, isliye iske sath 'my' possessive adjective sahi hoga, isliye option C 'mind my staying' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: We watched the workers to be unloading heavy wooden crates from the truck.
questions.solution: Kuch verbs jaise 'let, bid, make, notice, watch, feel etc.' inke baad bare infinitive aate hai, isliye 'to be unloading' ko bare infinitive mein likhenge, isliye option B 'unload' sabse sahi answer hoga. Note:- gerund bhi aa sakta hai jab usne jhalak dekhi hoti uss kaam ki, agar poora action dekha hai toh bare infinitive. Dono ke apna-apna meaning hai. 'unloading' option nahi hai, isliye sirf option B sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Read books every day helps a person develop deeper understanding, better vocabulary, and stronger imagination over time.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'helps' verb di hai toh 'read' ko verb nahi bana payenge, isliye 'read' ko gerund 'reading' mein change karke 'reading' subject ban jaaayega aur 'books' object of gerund ban jaaayega, toh 'reading books' ka matlab 'books padhna' hai, isliye option C 'reading books' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As been a doctor, she understood the seriousness of the patient's condition even before the reports came.
questions.solution: 'Been' verb ki 3rd form bina helping ke galat hogi, isliye option C aur D galat honge. Sentence ka matlab dena 'ek doctor hone ki wazah se, wo samajh jaati hai patient ki condition ko', toh sentence mein kisi ke baare mein kuch bata rahe hai, jiske liye 'being a doctor' structure sahi hoga, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Since rest of the employees have already left, let we lock the office carefully and leave the building.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'let' verb hai jiske baad 'object + object complement' ka structure banta hai, isliye 'we' ka objective case 'us' aayega aur 'lock' object complement ka kaam karega, isliye option C 'let us lock' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Even after they were shown the CCTV footage, the students repeatedly denied to break any classroom equipment during the lunch break.
questions.solution: 'denied' ke baad gerund aayega kyunki 'denied' ka use past mein kisi baat ko mana karne ke liye hota hai jiske sath gerund aate hai, isliye 'denied breaking' option C sahi answer hoga. Note:- 'refuse' ka use future mein koi kaam ko mana karne ke liye use hota hai, aur future ke action ko batane ke liye infinitive ka use hota hai, isliye refuse ke sath infinitive aate hai.

questions.question: Have completed the registration, the volunteers immediately moved to the main hall to get the detailed instructions for the event.
questions.solution: Jab sentence mein batana ho ki ek kaam khatam hone ke baad dusra kaam hua, toh iske liye perfect participle(having + v3) ka use karte hai. Sentence mein pata chal raha hai registration ke baad volunteers main hall mei gaye hai, isliye registration wala kaam perfect participle mein aayega, isliye option D 'having completed the registration' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She was deeply disappointed to be rejected in the final round of the interview even after performing exceptionally well in all the earlier stages of the selection process.
questions.solution: 'disappoint' ke sath 'at' preposition aati hai aur 'at' preposition ka object infinitive nahi ho sakta kyunki 'at' aur 'to' preposition sath mein galat hongi, isliye 'disappointed at' ke baad gerund aaayega wo bhi passive form mein kyunki usne kisi ko reject nahi kiya, balki wo reject hui hai, isliye gerund ka passive 'being rejected' sahi hoga, isliye option B 'disappointed at being rejected' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He was disappointed to be missed the his train to Delhi.
questions.solution: 'disappoint' ke sath 'at' preposition aati hai aur 'at' preposition ka object infinitive nahi ho sakta kyunki 'at' aur 'to' preposition sath mein galat hongi, isliye 'at' preposition ka object banne ke liye 'missing' gerund(noun) sahi hoga, isliye option A 'disappointed at missing' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Be responsible and disciplined will significantly help you achieve long-term success in any professional.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'will' verb se pata chal raha ki isse pehle noun ki jarurat hai, isliye 'be' ko gerund 'being' mein badalna padega, isliye option A 'being responsible and disciplined' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the old video of their childhood trip unexpectedly appeared on the big screen, everyone in the hall could not help but crying remembering those unforgettable moments.
questions.solution: 'can't/couldn't help' ke baad agar 'but' aaye toh iske baad bare infinitive ka use hota hai, aur agar 'but' na aaye toh gerund ka use hota hai, sentence mein could not ke baad 'but' aaya hai, isliye yahan bare infinitive 'cry' sahi hoga, isliye option B 'could not help but cry' sahi answer hoga.
